study_scope: three Honshu coastal sites and Izu Oshima, Niijima, Kozu, Miyake, Hachijo; 2013-2014 coastal plant-pollinator networks
permitted_inference: observed plant-pollinator interactions conditional on the archived sampling design
source-native pollinator functional-group use for plant taxa represented in the data
prohibited_inference: pollinator effectiveness from visit identity alone
floral trait evolution from interaction data alone
historical causation from the 2013-2014 network snapshot
